sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Ideological Basis**: Influenced by the **cult of the bomb**, inspired by Irish revolutionaries, Russian Nihilists, and the Italian Risorgimento.
• **Primary Objective**: To strike terror into the hearts of British officials and inspire the masses through **individual heroism**.
• **Organizational Structure**: Secret societies (Anushilan Samiti, Jugantar) operating in decentralized cells to prevent mass arrests.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The shift from 'Petition-Prayer-Protest' to 'Armed Insurrection' as a response to the brutal suppression of the Swadeshi Movement.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Literature**: Publication of 'Sandhya', 'Yugantar', and 'Kal' to spread revolutionary ideology.
• **Assassination Attempts**: Muzaffarpur (1908) by Khudiram Bose and Prafulla Chaki targeting Kingsford.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Lack of mass base, superior British intelligence (CID), and internal fragmentation.
• **Solutions**: Transition to mass-based movements (Gandhian era) while retaining the spirit of sacrifice.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'B-A-G' (Bengal, Abroad, Ghadar).
• **Decoded Meaning**: B (Bengal: Anushilan/Jugantar), A (Abroad: India House/Savarkar), G (Ghadar: Lala Hardayal/Sohan Singh Bhakna).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the 'Anushilan Samiti' (Bengal) with 'Abhinav Bharat' (Maharashtra). Remember: Anushilan = P. Mitra/Barindra Ghosh; Abhinav Bharat = V.D. Savarkar.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Revolutionary Terrorism' with caution; prefer 'Revolutionary Nationalism' to reflect the patriotic intent of the actors.

keyTakeaways: Revolutionary activities were a direct response to the failure of constitutional methods.
The movement was geographically diverse, spanning Bengal, Maharashtra, and international hubs.
Despite limited success in achieving immediate independence, they created a legacy of sacrifice that inspired future generations.
